description: Header file defining classes for text formatting in a logging system, including 'text_formatter' and 'contextual_text_formatter'.

classes.name: text_formatter
classes.description: Implements text formatting for log entries, managing scope and formatting states.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the formatter object.

methods.name: format_full_queue_error
methods.description: Formats an error message for full queue conditions.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a log entry given its metadata.

methods.name: format_metadata
methods.description: Formats metadata of a log entry.

methods.name: format_context_begin
methods.description: Formats the beginning of a context scope.

methods.name: format_context_end
methods.description: Formats the end of a context scope.

methods.name: format_metric_set_begin
methods.description: Formats the beginning of a metric set.

methods.name: format_metric_set_end
methods.description: Formats the end of a metric set.

methods.name: format_list_begin
methods.description: Formats the beginning of a list.

methods.name: format_list_end
methods.description: Formats the end of a list.

methods.name: format_metric
methods.description: Formats a metric with name, value, units, and kind.

methods.name: get_current_set_name
methods.description: Returns the current scope's set name.

methods.name: consume_element
methods.description: Consumes an element in the current scope.

methods.name: needs_comma
methods.description: Determines if a comma is needed based on scope state.

methods.name: get_indents
methods.description: Calculates indentation level based on nesting.
